subject: Request for pen-test report and scope details — AcmeBank account
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin O'Hare <kevin.ohare@acmebank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pen-test report request and scope clarification

Hi Laura,

We recently received an alert from our SOC team related to a credential stuffing campaign targeting a set of fintech vendors. Given the timing and the fact that AcmeBank is going through a vendor security re-assessment this quarter, our risk team is asking for a copy of Redwood's most recent penetration test report (or a redacted executive summary) and a clear statement of the test scope (what was in-scope / out-of-scope, whether authenticated API endpoints and SSO flows were tested, and which CVEs were validated).

Can you share:
- A redacted executive summary right away (we can accept redacted PoC details).
- Confirmation of whether the pen test included any authenticated flows or internal network assessments.
- Current remediation status for any findings classified as High or Critical (and ticket refs if available).

This is time-sensitive for our procurement team — ideally today or tomorrow — since the report is required for our renewal checklist. If you cannot provide the full report, please indicate the process and timeline to receive it (e.g., NDA, PO, or legal review).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jennings
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst — AcmeBank
security@acmebank.com

Attachments: none
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen-test report request and scope clarification

Hi Sarah — thanks for flagging and sorry for the stress this causes your team.

On Wed, 18 Feb 2026 at 09:15 Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com> wrote:
> We recently received an alert from our SOC team related to a credential stuffing campaign targeting a set of fintech vendors...

We can provide a redacted executive summary immediately; I'm attaching a PDF with the high-level findings and the scope summary. For full pen-test artifacts (detailed PoCs and raw logs) we require a standard mutual NDA and a short intake so we can redact any customer-identifying info. If AcmeBank prefers, we can also provide a targeted PoC excerpt (timestamps + steps) rather than the full raw output.

Summary (quick):
- Test date: Aug 2025 (external third-party vendor contracted by Redwood)
- In-scope: public web app, public API endpoints, SSO flows (OAuth redirect, token exchange), auth rate limiting.
- Out-of-scope: internal corporate network, on-prem customer environments, backups.
- High/Critical: 2 findings (both related to auth session handling and one insecure token storage in a third-party dependency) — both have remediation tickets and one has been fixed in Dec 2025.

I've looped in Marcus (security) who can provide the remediation tracker and ticket references. Attaching: pen_test_report_redacted_2025.pdf.

Next steps: please confirm if AcmeBank will sign an NDA (I can send one), and whether you want the remediation tracker and PoC excerpts. If this remains urgent for procurement, we can target a 48–72 hour turnaround on the full package once the NDA is in place.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0198

Attachments: pen_test_report_redacted_2025.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen-test report request and scope clarification — technical details and remediation status

Hi Sarah — Marcus from Redwood security here. Quick technical follow-up and remediation status.

Scope details: the engagements ran in Aug 2025 and covered: external attack surface (public-facing hosts and DNS records), the production public API (authenticated and unauthenticated endpoints), the OAuth-based SSO flow used by enterprise customers, and common third-party JS dependencies loaded on the web app. We did not perform internal network or employee workstation testing.

Findings & status: 
- Finding #A-2025-07 (High): insecure session invalidation on logout for a specific edge case — fix deployed Dec 3, 2025 and verified in our internal regression tests. Ticket: SEC-789.
- Finding #B-2025-12 (Critical): insecure storage in a transitive dependency that allowed token leakage under a rare sequence — mitigated via dependency upgrade and config change; verification completed Jan 15, 2026. Ticket: SEC-804.
- Low/medium items: several dependency upgrade recommendations scheduled on a normal cadence; tracker attached.

PoC and logs: we typically redact customer-identifying info before sharing PoCs. If you require specific timestamps and request/response samples for your SOC, we can extract those and provide them under a data-sharing agreement. We cannot share full raw host-level logs without an executed DPA/NDA and an authorized request from procurement or security.

Attached: remediation_plan_acmebank_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with status, owner, completion dates).

If helpful, I can join a short 30-minute bridge with your team to walk through the findings and the fixes — propose Fri 20 Feb 10:00 PT.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: remediation_plan_acmebank_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin O'Hare <kevin.ohare@acmebank.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen-test report request and scope clarification — urgent

Thanks Laura and Marcus — appreciate the quick responses.

On Thu, 19 Feb 2026 at 08:40 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Scope details: the engagements ran in Aug 2025 and covered: external attack surface...

Procurement is pushing back: they need the full pen-test report pdf (including PoC steps) to complete our renewal checklist. Our security policy allows redactions but requires that any shared PoC contain the attack timeline and enough detail for our team to validate the remediation.

We can complete an NDA quickly, but I also need confirmation that Redwood will provide the PoC excerpts (timestamps, request/response pairs) rather than only high-level descriptions. Additionally, if you have any PO or purchase-order requirements tied to releasing artifacts, please let me know — we can expedite on our side.

If you can't provide the full artifacts, please escalate to your leadership to discuss acceptable alternatives; the renewal window is tight.

—Sarah
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@acmebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen-test report request and scope clarification — next steps and NDA

Sarah — thank you. We're on it.

To summarize next steps and timelines: 
1) I'll send a standard mutual NDA via DocuSign right after this email (redwood template + one clause to protect third-party vendor data). Once executed, we will provide the full pen-test package with PoC excerpts (we will redact other customers' data). Target turnaround: 48 hours after NDA signature.
2) We will provide the remediation tracker (attached previously) and we can export targeted PoC excerpts (timestamps + request/response samples) for the two High/Critical findings.
3) If Procurement requires a formal PO before release, please send the PO to contracts@redwood.ai and we will prioritize the package upon receipt.

I've attached the mutual NDA draft for your legal team to review (nondisclosure_acmebank.docx). Marcus will be available on the bridge at the time he proposed if you want walk-through context; otherwise we can set an exec-to-exec call if Procurement needs to escalate.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0198

Attachments: nondisclosure_acmebank.docx (DOCX, 18KB)
